one_liner: Open‑source ecommerce plugin for WordPress with a comprehensive REST API for store management.
access_notes: admins generate keys in each WooCommerce store; no paid tier required for core REST API.
mcp_notes: WooCommerce AI exposes an official MCP server for stores (remote via WordPress.com OAuth, plus optional direct API‑key transport).

evidence.quote: You may use HTTP Basic Auth by providing the REST API Consumer Key as the username and the REST API Consumer Secret as the password.
To create or manage keys for a specific WordPress user, go to WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API.
Use `/wp-json/wc/v3/`… The … API allows you to create, view, update, and delete… [Coupons, Customers, Orders, Products, … Settings, Shipping, Webhooks, Reports].
WooCommerce can trigger webhook notifications each time you add, edit, or delete orders, products, coupons, or customers…

Connect an external Model Context Protocol (MCP) client to your store’s WooCommerce AI server… The WordPress.com URL includes your store identifier… [and] Optional: direct API‑key connection… accepts the X‑MCP‑API‑Key header in consumer_key:consumer_secret format.
